content: Architecture map: Scanner authority is src/scanners/inefficiency_reclaim.py:562 run_inefficiency_reclaim_screener (loads daily/1h/15m/5m/1m bars, evaluates strategy at :708 via src/strategy/inefficiency_reclaim.py:evaluate_strategy; StrategyCandidate there). Decision adapter src/decision/candidate_adapter.py:61 trade_signal_to_candidate creates stable candidate_id `gerchik-` + sha256(_stable_setup_payload)[:32] (mapping adapter :105 analogous). Source snapshot IDs src/decision/strategy_sources.py:315 current_source_snapshot_payload; per-source fingerprints sha256 canonical item dicts[:24], analysis_snapshot_id `analysis-`+sha256(identity)[:32] at :335; registry definitions in src/decision/strategy_definitions.py (definition_hash property :53 sha256 canonical JSON). Deterministic risk gate authoritative src/decision/policy.py:40 AutonomousRiskGate.evaluate_entry :46-163; uses calculate_position_size/position_value_ok and validate_trade, called in src/decision/agent.py:1360 with IBKR paper caps. Canonical pure order planner src/risk/order_planner.py:133 plan_order (CanonicalOrderPlan), but no plan hash field/function; insertion likely hash serialized plan.to_dict externally. Execution path: src/decision/agent.py:1449 onward reserves audit, builds broker_order_ref, guard then OrderManager.execute_trade; src/execution/order_manager.py:41 executes quote/autonomous guards -> validate_trade -> broker.place_market_bracket_order :144; src/brokers/ibkr.py IBKRClient, account identity :271, place_market_order :577, bracket :673/:783. Existing dashboard queue worker is separate src/execution/order_requests.py (JSON memory/order_requests.json, lock/atomic writes, heartbeat runtime/execute_worker.json), src/jobs/execute_requests.py:282 process_pending_once and :319 run_execute_requests; main.py:682 blocks duplicate worker. Account/mode flags src/decision/models.py:17 AgentMode incl IBKR_PAPER_AUTONOMOUS; src/config.py:190 DecisionAgentConfig env gates ALLOW_LLM_IBKR_PAPER_TRADING, LLM_IBKR_PAPER_ACCOUNT_ALLOWLIST, max positions/trades/risk at :240-249; validate around :254; SETTINGS.paper_trading/dry_run. Audit durable SQLite src/decision/audit.py:16 schema: agent_runs,candidates,decision_snapshots,model_decisions,risk_decisions,execution_links,reservations,position_events,outcomes,provider_health; reservations state/recovery methods. Recovery src/decision/agent.py:370 _recover_paper_reservations, :401 reconcile_live_reservations (also IBKR paper), execution uncertainty -> RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; order_requests heartbeat/recovery. Legacy journals src/journal/order_journal.py, broker_reconcile.py; IRS SQLite src/storage/inefficiency_reclaim_store.py. Trading MCP is read-only src/mcp/trading_bot_server.py FastMCP @mcp.tool tools get_symbol_snapshot, coverage, history, levels, render_chart, level_context; service src/mcp/trading_data_service.py reads persisted bars/watchlist and never broker/orders. No Hermes/Telegram implementation found in repo (grep only docs references). Dashboard status dashboard/app.py:680 render_trades reads queue/positions, worker heartbeat :701-709 and status metrics :689-698; Forecast placement queues order_requests. Relevant tests: tests/test_ibkr_paper_autonomous.py (mode validation, atomic reservation, caps, exactly-once execution/recovery); tests/test_order_planner.py; tests/test_order_flow.py; tests/test_trading_bot_data_mcp.py; tests/test_autonomous_stock_worker.py; tests/test_autonomous_llm_remediation.py. Minimal insertion points: Telegram approval should enqueue/record approval beside DecisionAudit reservation (not bypass agent policy), then invoke existing agent.process_candidate or queue worker; add approval metadata/order_ref/hash to audit schema; add Telegram adapter/server separate from read-only MCP; dashboard read audit/approval state.

Architecture findings: reuse order_requests atomic locked JSON queue + claim_pending/process_pending_once; worker sole broker caller. Reuse OrderManager autonomous guard or manual path only after approval, IBKRClient.get_account_identity paper_verified/account allowlist + order_ref bracket; decision RiskGate and audit SQLite reservation/execution links. MCP is read-only/stale persisted data, never execution/final quote validation. Telegram layer absent; add immutable candidate snapshot/nonce, authorized chat/user allowlist, expiry, one-time approve/reject transition, enqueue only revalidated approved request. Risks: submit_place live bool is caller-controlled and unsafe approval primitive; execute_requests live=True bypasses DRY_RUN, so Telegram path force paper and reject mode mismatch. Queue PROCESSING has no automatic stale recovery. Manual path bypasses autonomous gates, thus run deterministic gate/account sync/fresh broker quote immediately before enqueue; audit failure -> reconciliation.
